## Description (説明)
- .vimrc の英語翻訳機能(	r)で翻訳後に画面描画が乱れる
- 翻訳前の日本語や、フッタの一部が編訳後の画面に残る

## Steps to Reproduce (再現手順)
1. 日本語文章全体を選択する（ggVG)
2. 翻訳を実行する（	r）

## Expected Outcome (期待される結果)
画面描画が乱れないようにする

Optional additional information.

title: Screen rendering is corrupted after translation with the English translation function ( r) in ./.vimrc
label: bug
assignee: @.config/karabiner_elements
milestone:
---

## Description
- The screen rendering is corrupted after using the English translation function ( r) in .vimrc.
- The original Japanese text and parts of the footer remain on the screen after translation.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Select the entire Japanese text (ggVG).
2. Execute the translation ( r).

## Expected Outcome
To prevent the screen rendering from being corrupted.

Optional additional information.
